vocabTest.title: Free English vocabulary test
vocabTest.metaTitle: Free English vocabulary test: how many words do you know?
vocabTest.metaDescription: Take a free 2-minute English vocabulary size test. See about how many words you know, your level from A1 to C2, and books you can read.
vocabTest.intro: You see one English word at a time with four meanings. Pick the right one, or tap “Not sure” if you do not know it: guessing makes the result less accurate. After 20 words you can see your result; the more you answer, the narrower the range. The test covers words up to the 40,000 most common. We do not store your answers on our server. Your last result stays in this browser for 30 days.
vocabTest.explain: This is an estimate. It counts word families, such as "help", "helps" and "helped" as one word.
vocabTest.missedTitle: Words you may not know yet
vocabTest.missedHint: You answered these wrong or chose “Not sure”. The right meaning is shown.
